activity.role: Diplomatic envoy and head of the Keicho Embassy
activity.notes: Date Masamune, lord of the Sendai domain, appointed Hasekura Tsunenaga as leader of the Keicho-era Mission to Europe. The mission departed Tsukinoura on 28 October 1613, travelled via New Spain to Spain and Rome, sought missionary support and a trade relationship with Mexico, and returned to Sendai on 20 September 1620.

sources.title: Materials Related to the Keicho-era Mission to Europe Japan and Spain — Memory of the World nomination
sources.citation_text: The Japan-Spain nomination identifies Hasekura Tsunenaga as leader of Date Masamune's Keicho-era Mission to Europe, records departure from Tsukinoura on 28 October 1613, its diplomatic and trade purposes, and return to Sendai on 20 September 1620.

sources.title: Address of John Paul II to a Japanese pilgrimage, 4 March 1985 — Holy See
sources.citation_text: The Holy See records that Date Masamune sent his personal envoy Hasekura Rokuemon Tsunenaga in 1613 and that Pope Paul V received Hasekura in 1615.
